import math
import sys

a, b, c = map(int, sys.stdin.read().split())

if b <= c:
    g = math.gcd(a, b)
    print(f"{a // g}/{b // g}")
else:
    max_diff_index = -1
    s = 1
    for idx in range(1, c + 1):
        j = (idx * a) // b
        if abs(idx * a - j * b) > abs(idx * a - (j + 1) * b):
            j += 1
        if max_diff_index == -1 or abs(s * a - max_diff_index * b) * idx > abs(idx * a - j * b) * s:
            max_diff_index = j
            s = idx
    print(f"{max_diff_index}/{s}")
